meta.case: the pin set on a channel changed

semantics.object_ref: the channel's pin set as of d.last_pin_timestamp
semantics.target_ref: none — the event names NO message
semantics.actor: none — the event does not say who pinned/unpinned
semantics.source_time: d.last_pin_timestamp — the most recent pin's time only

native_fields.last_pin_timestamp: ISO8601|null (null when the last pin was removed)

semantics.notes: A scoped snapshot hint, not a transition: which message changed, who did it and whether it was pin or unpin all require a channel.pins() read — or the type-6 CHANNEL_PINNED_MESSAGE system message that accompanies a pin. last_pin_timestamp null means the set went empty. Coverage is partial by construction.
